content.short: Saturn issues USDat, a stablecoin backed by tokenized Treasuries, and sUSDat, which earns yield from structured credit strategies.
content.description: Saturn calls itself onchain structured digital credit and draws on Michael Saylor's idea of digital credit. Users swap USDC into USDat with no lock-up and stake it as sUSDat to earn yield from Treasury and DeFi strategies, collecting protocol points along the way. The project was incubated by YZi Labs and has support from Sora Ventures and The Spartan Group. All the main actions, from minting to staking and bridging, run in one app, institutions get their own service, and US residents cannot take part.
